title: Prepare a USB for your DJ player — CDJ, XDJ, Prime — Alpha-DJ-Engine
description: Prepare a USB for CDJ, XDJ, Prime and more: Alpha-DJ-Engine analyzes your music, builds a harmonic set and writes the library your player reads natively. Pick your device for the exact guide.

groups.title: Denon DJ & Numark — Engine DJ USB
groups.blurb: Alpha writes a standard Engine OS 3.x library straight to the stick — the whole Engine DJ family reads it natively, no Engine desktop session needed.

groups.title: Pioneer DJ & AlphaTheta — rekordbox USB
groups.blurb: Alpha writes both rekordbox libraries plus beat grids, waveforms and artwork directly — the stick plugs straight into the player, no rekordbox software anywhere. A new target: please confirm it on your own gear.
